title: Windows actor-audit receipt hash did not match the CRLF-written file

title: Long audio DMA gaps lose elapsed playback time
status: Source-checked: a real mixer fixture reproduces lost ring wraps after long unpolled gaps; the EClock-based candidate passes four focused Docker methods and a 68040 compile. Delivery and native listening not recorded; not a cure for all WinUAE crackle. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#audio-clock-29-long-dma-gaps-lose-elapsed-playback-time-source-repair-candidate).

title: Effects volume should default to 75%
status: Effects default set to 75% with other mixer defaults and saved preferences unchanged; eight focused checks; included in RC2 and v0.0.29. Owner mixing playtest pending. [Record](RC2_ISSUE_CHECKPOINT.md#repairs-included-in-the-rc2-candidate).

title: Seyda Neen walking reaches water before the island handoff
status: Handoff now derived from the authored LAND bounds; host border/rebasing checks pass, and the rc1 notes record native walking Seyda Neen to terrain and back. That native pass predates the rc1 source reconciliation. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#1-october-2026-dev1-to-rc1-recovery).

title: Dry valleys and rises rendered as flooded after coarse terrain conversion
status: Shoreline refinement inserts original height samples; source-mesh audit finds zero wet/dry mismatches. Source-mesh evidence only; the original camera view and native shoreline visuals were not verified. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#1-october-2026-dev1-to-rc1-recovery).

title: Map marker reported stale; HUD lacked global/local positions
status: Shared exterior transform, per-draw marker refresh and global/local HUD shipped in v0.0.25-rc1; host tests and native captures show the marker moving. The original report's cause was not isolated, so it is not marked fixed. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#1-october-2026-dev1-to-rc1-recovery).

title: M/N switched to the desktop, including while typing in the console
status: M/N input filter, Right-Amiga-to-Ctrl alias removed, debug-only Alt+M. Native input probe passes map, console 'nm', Alt+M and system return after a return-path regression was found and corrected. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#1-october-2026-dev1-to-rc1-recovery).

title: Console typed only uppercase letters and shifted digits
status: Qualifier sync, letters-only Caps Lock and raw 0x30 corrections pass a compiled lost-release host test and are retained in v0.0.25-rc2. No native stuck-Shift reproduction or owner confirmation recorded. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#1-october-2026-dev1-to-rc1-recovery).

title: Quicksave shown as empty; save ordering confusing
status: Open. Code inspection confirms the load menu labels absent, corrupt and incompatible saves alike; menu/generation display is TODO and the ordering report needs the affected saves. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#1-october-2026-dev1-to-rc1-recovery).

title: Python FS-UAE launcher not executable after extraction
status: Source packers preserve and validate mode 0755; archive modes and extraction checked, and the rc2 changelog retains the launcher fix. Host packaging behavior only; no native run claimed. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#1-october-2026-dev1-to-rc1-recovery).

title: Area build aborted on exterior window assets reused indoors
status: Window flattening limited to exterior scenes; synthetic interior regression and the real Warehouse conversion pass, with exterior output byte-identical. Not complete build acceptance. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#aw25-08-area-build-aborts-on-window-mounting--v0025-rc2).

title: Image stage rejected the world/journal receipt after terrain
status: Receipt writer enumerates only the four UI-owned files; a mixed-directory regression covers repeat generation and corrupted-journal rejection. World UI now validates before terrain; no final game HDF passed in this record. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#aw25-09-image-rejects-worldjournal-receipt-after-terrain--v0025-rc3).

title: Actor-contact failures stopped image assembly only after terrain
status: v0.0.25-rc6 runs the strict contact gate before world-terrain and adds a labeled private-test acceptance. The 23 placement findings stay unresolved in this record; contact fitting followed in v0.0.25-rc7 under a separate entry. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#aw25-10--actor-contact-blocks-image-assembly-after-terrain).

title: Bounded Balmora maps exceed the 600-entity limit
status: Cause established: the scenery catalogue admitted only the balmora alias, so bmNNN maps kept func_wall entities. Name-predicate candidate passes extended Linux native fixtures; final live-slot, heap and target gates pending; fixed version not recorded. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#balmora-capacity-005-retained-town-maps-exceed-entity-admission).

title: Balmora Temple lower rooms: missing walls and floors, collision holes
status: Converter applied a NIF root rotation that Morrowind ignores; the rebuilt Temple matches OpenMW at the reported views in FS-UAE. Owner informally rated the dev5 look OK; lower-level walking/collision and formal owner acceptance pending. [Record](bugs/BALMORA-TEMPLE-GEOMETRY-29.md).

status: Pre-existing baked-data defect exposed by the optimizer. One-face regeneration passes 15 focused tests, all-face checks and the full 2,717-map optimizer, contact and static heap gates. Static build evidence only; producer-wide correction pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#bsp-light-01-pre-existing-vodunius-lightmap-range-exceeds-its-lump).

title: Image assembly was given the QCC source directory as its compiler
status: Assembly-wrapper configuration error, not engine code. Corrected wrapper and executable preflight let the next image run start; the record keeps it open until final assembly and target validation. [Record](bugs/ENTITY-EXHAUSTION-007.md#build-qcc-path-008-assembly-received-a-source-directory-as-its-compiler).

title: Image-repair retry omitted region-ownership files
status: Build-helper defect caught before any HDF patch. Helper now copies the authenticated ownership files; the rc5 retry passed actor/contact (zero unresolved), all 2,717 heap estimates and HDF readbacks. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#build-repair-01-ownership-files-omitted-by-rc5-retry-extractor-bug--build-tool).

title: Retry assertion rejected an empty failure list as a failure
status: Assertion now matches the receipt's empty-list schema; rc5 was built after the correction with optimizer, contact, static heap and readback gates passing. Build/package checks only. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#build-repair-02-retry-assertion-misread-an-empty-failure-list-bug--build-tool).

status: Recorded exception again for v0.0.32 (owner decision, 8 October 2026): shipped Seyda stages used as a recorded input, now the builder option --seyda-recorded, checked byte for byte after every image pass; one named difference: seyda.bsp ships as the sn029 fallback alias (owner option A; the complete town fails the release actor gate); Seyda Neen is rebuilt by the world streamer (v0.0.33), so the legacy builder is not fixed; sn019, sn026, sn035 pass the strict heap gate through a temporary pre-CHIM bypass (HEAP-SEYDA-OVERLAP-32, until CHIM M2)

title: Census Office objects misplaced (upright rug, ceiling hole, tapestry)
status: Fixed in v0.0.30-rc1: the dev4 object list plus dev5 flames; all 140 object-to-model pairs match dev4. Owner playtest 7 October 2026 (WinUAE): Census office interiors work.

title: Semicolons in default-config comments ran as console commands
status: Comment separators replaced and the test now rejects semicolons in default comments; both full host suites, Amiga compiles and image007 packaged readback pass. Actual default-startup validation pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#cfg-01-startup-comments-split-into-console-commands).

status: Bounded fractional remainder kept and cleared on explicit changes, waits and transitions; host fixtures, 63 native methods and both host suites pass, with bounded native clock checks in later images. Not every saved-clock lifecycle is certified. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#clock-01-automatic-clock-discarded-fractional-milliseconds).

title: Semicolons split default-config comments into commands
status: The dev2 source correction replaces semicolons in all five affected comments; the existing regression and full Linux suite pass. The record claims no target-verified fixed version; native startup was not tested. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#config-comment-29-semicolon-splits-a-default-comment-repair-candidate).

title: Converter applied NIF root-node rotation to placed meshes
status: Partial: converter fixed and Temple, Tharys Tomb and five fireplace interiors rebuilt in v0.0.30-dev3. One Balmora exterior furn_pathspear_03 placement is pending; walking/collision and fireplace-interior playtests also pending. [Record](bugs/CONVERTER-ROOT-ROTATION-30.md).

title: Heap exhaustion on sn012 after Hors travel from Jiub name entry
status: Cause established: visibility data held twice in Hunk after the rc3 apron growth. Loader repair and bounded maps ship in v0.0.27 and pass static gates; the original route and target lifecycle are unverified, so it stays open. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#crash-01-rc3-hors-restart-from-jiub-name-entry).

title: Fatal engine exit returned to AmigaDOS without a visible reason
status: Versioned crash banner, reason and verified ERROR.TXT write compiled into v0.0.27. A controlled malformed-map fatal-report check passed in the v0.0.28 native acceptance; full/read-only directories and other error paths untested. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#crash-report-02--visible-fatal-exit-report).

title: Hands unavailable in the combat and torch test rooms
status: Pre-activation timing transfer and explicit test-room input gates repaired; regression fails before repair. A later native run showed punch, torch off/on/off after appearance choice and return to the ordinary state. [Record](bugs/DEBUG-GALLERY-TIMING-29.md).

title: Static foliage leaf links exhausted ('Too many efrags!')
status: Map-owned link pages (hard cap 65,536) pass sanitizer regressions, the all-map estimator audit and both host suites; a bounded native route peaked at 52,176 links with clean exit and reboot. Not all-world or real-hardware proof. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#efrag-01-static-foliage-leaf-links-exhausted-in-image004).

title: Entity-exhaustion warning reports the high-water count as live slots
status: Source review only: exhaustion can occur below 600 live entities while freed slots are quarantined. Reproduction not run; diagnostic correction not implemented. [Record](bugs/ENTITY-EXHAUSTION-007.md#entity-diagnostic-009-allocation-high-water-count-described-as-live-slots).

title: Entity slot exhaustion terminated the game with Sys_Error
status: Mitigation only: aw_ent_count_exceed_soft_fail (default 1) warns and ends the session safely; the real-allocator Docker test passes. Not a capacity fix; packaged and target behavior pending. [Record](bugs/ENTITY-EXHAUSTION-007.md).

title: Dense vegetation exceeds the per-map entity reserve
status: Adaptive collision-packing candidate passes host reserves (vf2098: 504 entities) with no scenery removed. Signon/heap and target collision/traversal gates pending; fixed version not recorded. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#flora-entity-001-dense-vegetation-exceeds-the-entity-reserve).

title: Two world flora maps exceed storage and clipnode reserves
status: Candidate splits vf0698 and vf0791 into four cores each; the refined retry passes 2,532 regions covering all 19,984 references within reserves, plus 34 focused checks. Final image, runtime memory and target acceptance pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#flora-reserve-002-two-full-world-rc1-flora-candidates-exceed-reserves).

title: Giant mushroom cap gaps after material-wise mesh reduction
status: Material sections sharing source vertices are kept with original UVs; a shared-rim regression and rebuilt BSP budget checks pass. Owner accepted the closed caps in the rc2 WinUAE playtest. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#geo-01-giant-mushroom-cap-gaps-after-material-wise-reduction---2-october-2026).

title: Seyda Neen ground ends before the world terrain handoff
status: Authored LAND apron and shared world sampling introduced in v0.0.27-rc3 and carried into v0.0.27; static gates and readbacks pass. Exact boundary playtest not recorded; no emulator acceptance claimed. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#geo-02-seyda-neen-ground-disappears-before-the-world-handoff).

title: Canonical clipping stored reversed-winding fragments
status: Clip helper and both canonical writers corrected; the house fixture shows zero reversed loops and 30 focused tests pass. No full-scene BSP rebuild, production integration or native result recorded. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#geo-03-canonical-clipping-stores-reversed-winding-fragments-in-diagnostic-023).

status: Rejected repair trial in v0.0.28-rc1 development. A coplanar-patch merge experiment is proposed; neither that rebuild nor full-world canonical culling is accepted. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#geo-04-canonical-terrain-world-hits-the-vis-portal-limit).

title: Night-guard torches not admitted on cold visits
status: Alias staging no longer evicts the hot actor cache; focused regressions pass. Image015 native acceptance admitted all three guards for both factions with zero skips/evictions and correct torch time boundaries. Reserve warning remains open. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#guard-cold-28-automatic-guard-torch-admission-failed-on-cold-visits-closed-with-bounded-native-verification).

title: Fists disappear once per idle breathing cycle
status: QuakeC floor rebound from builtin #36 (rint) to #37; Docker fixture with negative control passes and FS-UAE shows no dropouts in 1,500 frames. Included in v0.0.29-dev4 per its hotlist; owner WinUAE acceptance pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#hand-idle-blink-29-fists-disappear-once-per-breathing-cycle-native-verified).

title: Hands briefly disappear when changing into the punch animation
status: Owner report against the proposed-fix punch clip; listed as a known issue in v0.0.29. Frame-by-frame reproduction, cause and repair pending; separate from maximum-extension coverage. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#follow-up-evidence-and-open-reports-2026-10-06t2006100300).

title: Source handoff wrapper reused an existing extraction directory
status: Transfer-wrapper defect; no source, runtime or HDF change. Repair-002 isolates each extraction by archive checksum and verifies members; the exact-layout Docker test passes. v0.0.27 was then published from a later repair package. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#handoff-wrapper-01-direct-unzip-wrapper-collided-with-an-existing-extraction-handoff-tool-bug).

title: Private image refresh left file-owned blocks marked free
status: Allocation bitmap was not flushed before the device closed. Image006 closes the volume first; owned-block checks and native write/exit/reboot checks pass with no missing files. Private image-assembly tooling only. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#hdf-writer-01-private-image005-refresh-left-owned-blocks-free).

title: Held Ctrl/Shift flight modifiers reset on cell changes
status: Automatic crossings keep held input while doors and teleports still clear it; the real transition harness passes in both variants. Carried into v0.0.27; owner Shift/Ctrl/focus playtest pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#input-01-held-flight-modifiers-reset-on-cell-changes---rc3-correction-awaiting-playtest).

title: NUM_FOR_EDICT bad-pointer crash on a Seyda Neen region change
status: Stale intro role pointers are validated against the current entity list. Scripted FS-UAE route: dev3 crashed 2/2, repaired engine 0/3. Full opening sequence and owner acceptance pending. [Record](bugs/INTRO-ROLES-30.md).

Native OFF/ON views and frame cost pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#land-horizon-gaps-29-sky-visible-through-distant-resident-ground-open).

title: Texture scale changes dynamic-light reach on surfaces
status: Confirmed in the real surface accumulator; the UV-normalized candidate passes 85 comparisons, six sanitized Docker methods and a 68040 compile. Delivery and native appearance/performance not recorded. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#light-uv-distance-29-texture-scale-changes-dynamic-light-reach-source-repair-candidate).

title: Linux test fixtures failed to link (missing stubs)
status: Fixture stubs added; full Linux Docker suite (558 tests, 3 skips) and asset-free compile pass, verified in the published v0.0.27 source with hosted CI. Test linkage only. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#linux-valid-02-linux-test-fixture-link-failures-repaired-validation-issue).

status: Cause: focus resets did not clear the world-UI drag flag. Candidate passes all 11 sanitizer fixture cases (baseline fails 4). Native focus dispatch untested; no verified fixed version. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#map-focus-drag-29-map-or-journal-keeps-dragging-after-focus-returns-open).

title: Requested: click to place a user map marker
status: Feature request. A saved click marker is implemented in source and world-UI/save-codec fixtures pass in Docker; native acceptance pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#map-marker-29-click-to-place-a-user-map-marker-requested).

status: rc4 regression. Landmarks drawn in both modes and the active selector restyled; nine focused checks and the native world-UI fixture pass; included in v0.0.27. Owner target validation pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#map-reg-01-rc4-in-game-selector-hides-retained-settlement-markers-bug--regression).

[Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#mem-geometry-01-transactional-geometrylight-sharing-candidates).

title: Rebundled ZIPs lost exec modes; Windows path aliases accepted
status: Preparation-helper correction preserves modes and rejects nonportable names; five synthetic checks pass. No delivered release known affected; version not recorded; final-package extraction audit pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#package-portability-28-source-zip-modes-and-windows-path-aliases).

title: Original punch swing/hit sound coverage unverified
status: Open follow-up: inventory original samples, converted equivalents and event wiring. Listed as a known issue in v0.0.29. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#follow-up-evidence-and-open-reports-2026-10-06t2006100300).

status: Owner screenshot report near global -10940,-74750,81. Object identity and cause unknown; source-bound reproduction pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#rock-flora-surface-29-newly-appeared-angular-rock-like-surfaces-open).

title: Quickload returns with hands and torch put away
status: Cause established: AWS3 saves store no equipment intent. An AWS4 candidate passes save and compatibility checks; native quickload and integration pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#save-equipment-29-quickload-returns-with-hands-and-torch-put-away).

title: Rare freeze during a Seyda Neen region load
status: Rare freeze during Seyda Neen region loads in automated FS-UAE runs (about 5 in 70). Cause open; next: breakpoint on the refill read, test pausing music streaming during loads.

title: Dense clouds still hide the midnight sky
status: Default midnight clearing implemented in dev3 source; 15 renderer fixture modes pass and dev4 enables it by default. Native visual and frame-cost acceptance pending; related owner appearance acceptance is under SKY-NIGHT-COVER-29. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#sky-midnight-29-default-nightly-clearing-dev3-source-candidate).

title: Sky-only day/night remap clashed with gray distance fog
status: Uniform remaps with coordinated sky and fog targets pass fixtures, both host gates and image007 checks. Native matched-view visual acceptance pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#sky-visual-01-sky-only-daynight-remap-conflicts-with-gray-fog).

title: No dbg tp X Y; map teleport could land underwater
status: Coordinate form and water-surface placement pass four Docker native fixtures. No emulator or target result; fixed version not recorded. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#teleport-xy-006-explicit-global-coordinates-and-water-safe-debug-arrival).

status: Test-only: the configuration test now decodes UTF-8 and passes under default Windows encoding; rooted invocation keeps the intended tests. No runtime impact; version not recorded. title: Pre-release test fixtures assumed host features and links
status: Fixture link and platform-mock repairs pass both full host suites locally. Test-only; the record claims no published fixed version. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#test-portability-01-pre-release-fixture-dependencies-and-host-assumptions).

title: Torch never burns out; no unlit or fuel state
status: Open design: source light duration and zero/negative semantics unverified; compact state proposal only. Listed as a known issue in v0.0.29. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#rc1-owner-torch-follow-up-6-october-2026).

status: Running depth-bob mitigation and a fourth-vertex alias-clip correction pass source fixtures; neither is shown to explain every fragment. Standing/idle visual acceptance pending. [Record](journals/BUG_JOURNAL-v0.0.29.md#torch-hand-separation-29-grip-appears-to-break-during-idle-animation-open).

status: Palette generation keeps a 15% minimum. Room-scoped fix and native off/on comparison pending; listed as a known issue in v0.0.29. [Record](bugs/DEBUG-GALLERY-TIMING-29.md#separate-issue-torchtest-darkness-29).

status: Selection now unions bounds membership with existing bound source keys; 19 interpreted tests and all 66 Seyda binding checks pass. Assembled and target fixed version pending.
